RAG & SEARCHNovember 2, 20265 min read

Balancing accuracy and cost in RAG systems

A strong RAG system does more than retrieve the most similar chunk; it balances retrieval quality, reranking latency, and generation cost within the same decision function. In practice, expanding the candidate pool with hybrid search and running the reranker only for uncertain queries improves answer reliability without using the most expensive model for every request. Success should therefore be measured with an evaluation set that tracks source accuracy, latency, and cost per request together—not with a single accuracy metric.

LATEX EXAMPLE
$$S(d,q)=\alpha\,S_{dense}(d,q)+(1-\alpha)\,S_{sparse}(d,q)$$
PYTHON
def hybrid_score(dense, sparse, alpha=0.65):
    """Combine dense and sparse scores."""
    return alpha * dense + (1 - alpha) * sparse
